[Root.GetName]在[From.GetName]的轨道上有了惊人的发现。该星球上每单位空间内的量子叠加态数量，超出了至今为止被认为是可能数量的上限。

科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]提议称[From.GetName]，这颗被[Root.Leader.GetSheHe]命名为面纱的星球，同时存在于两个维度：我们的维度，以及另一个未知维度。

不仅如此，星球周围粒子场中的量子态数量仍在稳定增长。目前没有确凿的理论可以解释这一现象。[Root.GetLeaderName]假设灵能——

通讯变成了杂讯。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] has made an incredible discovery in orbit of [From.GetName]. The planet possesses a hitherto thought impossible number of superimposed quantum states per unit of space.

Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] suggests [From.GetName], which [Root.Leader.GetSheHe] codenamed The Veil, exists simultaneously in two dimensions: our own, and an unknown other.

What is more, the number of quantum states in the particle fields surrounding the planet is increasing at a constant rate. As of yet, there is no confirmed theory that could account for this phenomenon. [Root.GetLeaderName] posits that the psionic energy surr ---

The transmission crackles out to static.

label.en: What is going on out there?

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]船员为其初次报告被打断而道歉。在通讯中，[phaseshift_planet.GetName]经历了一次彻底的维度转移，它的粒子场旋转进了另一个维度！灵能云团已经消散，显露了一颗宝贵的盖亚星球。

迷人的是，随着星球的转移，其量子叠加态似乎已被重置，并且正在以星球仍被虚境星球时同等的速度增长。

[Root.GetLeaderName]用量子叠加态的增长速度，以及转移时的量子叠加态总量，推测出星球的转移周期为三个月。或许我们可以设法阻止星球的转移……但首先我们得拥有星系的控制权。
texts.en:
The [Root.GetName] crew apologizes for the abrupt termination of their initial report. During transmission, [phaseshift_planet.GetName] experienced a complete dimensional phase shift, its particle fields rotating out of one dimension and into another! The cloud of psionic energy has been lifted, revealing a glittering jewel of a Gaia World.

Fascinatingly, the number of superimposed quantum states appears to have been reset as the planet shifted, and is now increasing at the same rate as when the planet was a Shrouded World.

[Root.GetLeaderName] has used the rate of increase of particle superimposition, and the total number of quantum states at the time of transition to extrapolate a three-month cycle for the planet's dimensional shifts. Perhaps we might develop a method to prevent the planet from shifting... but we should secure the system first.

迷人的是，随着星球的转移，其量子叠加态似乎已被重置，并且正在以星球仍是个盖亚星球时同等的速度增长。

Fascinatingly, the number of superimposed quantum states appears to have been reset as the planet shifted, and is now increasing at the same rate as when the planet was a Gaia World.

[Root.GetLeaderName] has used the rate of increase of particle superimposition, and the total number of quantum states at the time of transition to extrapolate a three-month cycle for the planet's dimensional shifts. texts.en: Now that [phaseshift_planet.GetName] is within our borders, we should investigate the possibility of stabilizing the planet's state of dimensional flux. If we wish to inhabit the glittering Gaia World, we will have to devise a method of preventing [phaseshift_planet.GetName] from phase-shifting back into Shrouded World every three months.

texts.zh:
我们在[phaseshift_planet.GetStarName]星系内新获得的星球[phaseshift_planet.GetName]展现出了一些非同寻常的特性。它被一种只能称之为灵能的能源所包围，[phaseshift_planet.GetName]每单位空间内的量子叠加态数量，超出了至今为止被认为是可能数量的上限。

每隔三个月，叠加态数量就会达到临界值，使[phaseshift_planet.GetName]经历一次彻底的维度相位转移，它的粒子场将会旋转进另一个维度。该旋转会将一个虚境星球从另一维度转移至我们的维度，然后在下一个周期结束时再次将一个盖亚星球转移回来。

如果我们希望在那颗宝贵的盖亚星球上殖民，我们必须设法阻止[phaseshift_planet.GetName]每隔三个月就变为虚境星球。
texts.en:
Our newly acquired planet [phaseshift_planet.GetName] in the [phaseshift_planet.GetStarName] system exhibits some incredible properties. Occluded by a strange envelope of what can only be described as psionic energy, [phaseshift_planet.GetName] possesses a hitherto thought impossible number of superimposed quantum states per unit of space.

Every three months, the number of states reaches a critical level, and [phaseshift_planet.GetName] experiences a complete dimensional phase shift, its particle fields rotating out of one dimension and into another. This rotation phases a Shrouded World from another dimension into ours, only to phase back a Gaia World at the end of the next period.

If we wish to inhabit the glittering Gaia World, we will have to devise a method of preventing [phaseshift_planet.GetName] from shifting back into Shrouded World every three months.

label.zh: 那就想办法来相位锁定那颗星球吧。
label.en: Then let us find a way to phase-lock the planet.

label.zh: 我们还有更重要的事要处理。
label.en: We have more important matters to focus on.

我们的物理学家应该可以开发出相应的办法，将其锁定在其中一种状态之中，使之永久处于盖亚星球状态，不再变回另一种状态。
texts.en:
[phaseshift_planet.GetName], a planet in the [phaseshift_planet.GetStarName] System has been observed to phase-shift between a Shrouded World and Gaia World on a three month cycle.

Our physicists should be able to devise a way to lock the planet in one of its states, freezing it as a Gaia World, and preventing it from shifting back.

一道足够调谐的能源应该可以将[phaseshift_planet.GetName]固定为一个状态，将其锁定为一颗稳定的盖亚星球。
texts.en:
Following six months of number-crunching, theory-busting, and heated debate, the [Root.GetName] crew has devised a method by which the planet's particle fields can be locked into a nominal state, preventing their rotation between dimensions.

A sufficiently tuned pulse of energy should freeze [phaseshift_planet.GetName] in one state, locking it into a stable form as a Gaia World.

summary.text:
# 相变星球 / Phased Planet

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/solar_system_initializers/distant_stars_initializers.txt:3947 (distar_phaseshift_system); common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:11 (distar.252); events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:9485 (distar.252); common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1152; events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:9655-9686 (distar.256); common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:801-862; events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:9268 (distar.250); events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:9318 (distar.251); events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:9387 (distar.302); events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:9451 (distar.303); common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1934, 4189; events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:9568-9603 (distar.254); events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:9606 (distar.255); common/special_projects/00_projects_distant_stars.txt:617 (PHASESHIFT_PROJECT); events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:9505 (distar.253); events/distant_stars_events_1.txt:9689 (distar.258)

## 如何开始 How it starts

《遥远繁星》专属星系 distar_phaseshift_system 中有一颗每三个月在“遮蔽世界”与盖亚世界之间相变的星球（开局 distar.252 启动循环）。第一个勘察它的帝国通过隐藏事件 distar.256（on_survey_planet）得到10级异常“相变星球”；之后再勘察的帝国只收到通知 distar.258。

The Distant Stars system distar_phaseshift_system has a planet that phase-shifts between a Shrouded World and a Gaia World every three months (the cycle starts with distar.252 at game start). The first empire to survey it gets the level-10 anomaly "Phased Planet" through the hidden distar.256 (on_survey_planet); later surveyors only get the notice distar.258.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. 异常结果按调查时的状态三选一（各基础权重0，满足条件+1）：不拥有该星系且仍在相变 → distar.250，报告中途中断，1天后 distar.251 目睹星球相变；本帝国已拥有该星系且仍在相变 → distar.302；已被任何帝国锁定 → distar.303。三者都把星球命名为“面纱”(The Veil) 并给予物理学研究。
2. 任一帝国在该星系建成前哨或获得星系（on_building_starbase_outpost / on_starbase_transfer），隐藏 distar.254 在1天后给它 distar.255，并中止其他帝国的同名项目。
3. distar.255 选择锁定 → PHASESHIFT_PROJECT（180天，科研船+科学家）→ distar.253“相位锁定”：星球永久成为盖亚世界并获得一组矿藏；或放弃（获得影响力）。

1. The anomaly result depends on the state when researched (each base weight 0, +1 when its condition holds): system not ours and still shifting → distar.250, whose report breaks off, then distar.251 a day later witnesses the shift; system ours and still shifting → distar.302; already locked by anyone → distar.303. All three name the planet "The Veil" and give physics research.
2. When any empire builds an outpost in or acquires the system (on_building_starbase_outpost / on_starbase_transfer), the hidden distar.254 gives it distar.255 a day later and aborts other empires' identical projects.
3. distar.255: lock it → PHASESHIFT_PROJECT (180 days, science ship + scientist) → distar.253 "Phase Lock": the planet becomes a Gaia World permanently with a set of deposits; or decline (influence).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

异常的三个结果互斥（由星球与星系归属决定，不是随机）；distar.255 的两个选项互斥。锁定只能由一个帝国完成。

The three anomaly results are mutually exclusive (decided by planet/system state, not chance); distar.255's two options are exclusive. Only one empire can complete the lock.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

distar.251 正文按相变方向（变为盖亚或变为遮蔽）二选一；distar.302 按是否已有锁定项目二选一；distar.255 按是否已勘察过该星球二选一；事件图片随星球当前类型变化。

distar.251 has two texts by shift direction; distar.302 two texts by whether the lock project is already active; distar.255 two texts by whether the planet was surveyed; pictures follow the planet's current class.
